svg.text: Eight representative result curves from the committed V16-V55 record
Every panel is traced to a CSV result file and uses an explicit reference or failure interpretation.

g.text: Raw phase concentration rises with shared contamination; nuisance removal collapses it.

svg.text: Decision meaning: apparent field organization is not interpretable until shared-field confounds are ruled out.

g.text: The source estimate is prior-sensitive even when the measurement model is fixed.

svg.text: Decision meaning: a low sensor residual does not imply a unique or accurate source reconstruction.

g.text: Common-mode correlation lowers Fisher information and raises the Cramér-Rao variance floor.

svg.text: Decision meaning: correlated sensors can add channels without adding equivalent independent information.

g.text: Retained target information follows the exact sin² principal-angle law.

svg.text: Decision meaning: nuisance removal can destroy the target when the nuisance subspace is geometrically aligned.

g.text: Equal-prior Bayes error falls as covariance-aware source separation increases.

svg.text: Decision meaning: source classification claims require declared covariance geometry, not Euclidean separation alone.

g.text: Naive post-selection coverage collapses with search size
Selecting the strongest coordinate on the same data destroys nominal interval coverage.

svg.text: Decision meaning: discovery and confirmation must be separated; nominal intervals are not selection-safe.

g.text: A dominant site can collapse effective replication
Weight concentration reduces the number of independent sites actually supporting the pooled result.

svg.text: Decision meaning: nominal site count is misleading when one site carries most of the inverse-variance weight.

g.text: Hardware mismatch creates bounded amplitude bias
Observed relative bias grows with whitened topography mismatch and remains below the analytic bound.

svg.text: Decision meaning: transport across hardware requires an explicit mismatch budget, not visual similarity alone.
Provenance: v19, v23, v28, v34, v38, v44, v50, and v53 committed CSV records. Analytic/synthetic validation only; not empirical evidence that consciousness has been measured.
